verdict.rationale: Designing employee equity programs is a fair question for a startup law firm, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party text describing equity incentive or stock option plan design, or local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs. The nearest items are Section 409A/280G compliance on the Executive Compensation page and founder stock and 83(b) workflows via Clerky, which are adjacent features, not employee equity program design.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages
